_comment: Single source of brand identity for every generated document.
Before this existed, each generator typeset the wordmark as text — Georgia in
the Word documents, Times-Bold in the fillable PDF — while the platform itself
used the real logo artwork. Three renderings of one brand, none of them the
actual mark. Documents now embed the artwork below.
logo and mark are relative to this file, so the toolchain resolves them without
assuming where it was run from. Override any value with an environment variable
of the same name in upper case (BRAND_NAME, BRAND_LOGO, ...) to issue a document
under a licensed firm's identity instead of ours.
name: TitanOS
